Messages.Author: Oracle.kid
Messages.Body:
Combat always happens during action resolution by default, so I don't see why "queue" should happen "after action resolution".

IMHO it should therefore work the following:
action resolution:
- effect resolution (e.g. bleed resolution, referendum)
- after effect resolution window (e.g. cards "after referendum")
- queued combat after action resolution (e.g. Freak Drive)

> 3. Resolve the Action
>
> If the action is successful (all block attempts were unsuccessful), then the cost of the action is paid and the effects of the successful action take place.
>
> If the action is blocked, then any card played to perform the action is burned and the block is resolved with these two simultaneous consequences: the blocking minion is locked and enters combat with the acting minion (see Combat). If an effect ends the action before the block resolution or one of these two consequences (such as entering combat), neither consequence occurs. The effects of the action do not take place when the action is blocked. Note that the action’s cost, if any, is only paid if the action succeeds; the cost is not paid if the action is blocked. The costs of action modifiers and reaction cards are always paid when the cards are played, regardless of the success of the action.

Messages.Author: Oracle.kid
Messages.Body:
With this as baseline combat is only during action resolution.

> Ankha wrote:
> Here are the general guidelines:
> 1/ combats happen only during action resolution
> 2/ combats can be chained (extending the resolution)
> 3/ there's a window between combat to play "after combat" non-combat effects (such as Hidden Lurker (action modifier), but also Obedience (reaction))
> 4/ if the action is ending by a game state check (readiness), combats cannot added to the chain, but also it cannot be continued (even if you fix the state with Warsaw Station typically)"
>
Discord Hidden Lurker Thread

> Ankha wrote:
> If the action is blocked, then the action resolves with a "lock+enter combat" thing called "block resolution". That's the start of it. The action resolution can then be extended with more combats.
>
Discord Hidden Lurker Thread

> We figured that `after bleed resolution` is a part of `action resolution`, similar to `after combat` for Hidden Lurker. And that Voter Captivation would still be in the Freak Drive window, since it refers to `resolution of a political **action** whose referendum passed`. (Cards which refer to political actions would need to be `after referendum` for political actions to be in the same window.
>
> Ankha: it looks right
>
Discord Guardian Thread

So a queue extends the action resolution window. My take is it there can be multiple combats queued with multiple minions. E.g. Psyche! can still be played to start a new combat during a rush / block combat, and after all combats with the acting minion are resolved, Hedonism 1 combat and Hedonism 2 combat are resolved.
